receipts.title: Evaluating the economic impact of water scarcity in a changing world
verified_facts: 235 water basins and 32 geopolitical regions
six demand sectors include municipal, irrigation, livestock, manufacturing, primary energy, and electricity
endpoint is total consumer plus producer surplus difference between constrained and unlimited water scenarios
3000 factorial scenarios with 2876 completed
RCP4.5 hydrology forcing can be inconsistent with scenario emissions
raw data are available by request; processed data and calculation code are on Zenodo

receipts.title: GCAM.surplus v1.0.0 source repository
verified_facts: calc_net_surplus integrates paired constrained and unlimited supply-demand curves
repository requests GCAM v5.1.1
configurations, query files, and processed surplus output are present
raw supply and demand curve files are available only on request
published surplus units are billions of 1975 USD before figure conversion

receipts.title: Global Change Analysis Model v5.1.1
verified_facts: published water-surplus workflow specifies this model version
model is global and multisectoral

receipts.title: MimiFUND v3.13.0
verified_facts: annual water-resources output for 16 FUND regions
released wrbm.csv has one uncertain regional benchmark coefficient for every FUND region
Monte Carlo distributions cover water benchmark and response parameters
get_marginal_model constructs base and modified runs and accepts a tCO2 pulse
release spreads the emissions pulse over ten years and normalizes the reported social cost by pulse size
water component source indexes temperature by time and region

receipts.title: FUND 3.9 Scientific Documentation
verified_facts: water impact is a monetized reduced-form response in 1995 USD
documentation describes global mean temperature, income, population, technology, and regional benchmark terms
documentation does not provide a municipal-only welfare decomposition

receipts.title: Full Fuel Cycle Study: Evaluation of the Global Warming Externality for Fossil Fuel Cycles with and without CO2 Abatement and for Two Reference Scenarios
receipts.revision: Downing et al. 1996 report hosted by FUND
verified_facts: source discussion spans irrigation, urban water supply, amenity, ecosystem, and other water-resource impacts
no machine-readable municipal share of FUND regional water coefficients is released

receipts.title: Fluvial flood inundation and socio-economic impact model based on open data
verified_facts: globally applicable GloFAS-to-inundation implementation
hazard maps cover river catchments above 5000 km2
the demonstrated impact endpoint is population displacement
uncertainty analysis includes forecast ensemble, bootstrap return periods, and vulnerability functions
authors explicitly state the module is not a pluvial-flood model
software, data, and scripts are archived at Zenodo 10518953
